exam_facts.test: Doppler ultrasound imaging of the right lower limb
exam_facts.result: Evidence of significant femoropopliteal artery stenosis in the right leg.
Elicits pallor and tingling pain in the right foot.
No alterations noted besides tingling on straight leg raise.
Hemoglobin 14.2 g/dL; hematocrit 42.1%; WBC 6.3 × 10³/μL with normal differential; platelets 228 × 10³/μL

Sodium 139 mmol/L; potassium 4.3 mmol/L; creatinine 0.92 mg/dL; eGFR (CKD-EPI) 88 mL/min/1.73m²; ALT 24 U/L; AST 22 U/L; total cholesterol 218 mg/dL; LDL cholesterol 136 mg/dL; HDL cholesterol 38 mg/dL; triglycerides 224 mg/dL
Color: pale yellow; clarity: clear; pH 6.0; specific gravity 1.015; glucose 2+ (100 mg/dL); no ketones; no protein; no RBCs or WBCs; no casts
No lumbar spinal stenosis, no nerve root compression at L4–S1; no disc herniation or significant degenerative foraminal narrowing; normal cord signal and conus position

exam_facts.test: Electromyography and nerve conduction studies (right lower limb)
exam_facts.result: Normal motor and sensory amplitudes, latencies, and conduction velocities in tibial, peroneal, and sural nerves; no evidence of radiculopathy or peripheral neuropathy beyond expected mild distal symmetric sensorimotor slowing consistent with 8-year diabetes

exam_facts.test: Venous duplex ultrasound of right lower limb
exam_facts.result: No deep vein thrombosis; compressible femoral, popliteal, and posterior tibial veins; no venous reflux or obstruction

exam_facts.test: Contrast-enhanced CT angiography of abdominal aorta and bilateral lower extremities
exam_facts.result: Patent abdominal aorta and common iliac arteries; focal 75% diameter-reducing stenosis in the mid-right superficial femoral artery extending into the proximal popliteal artery; no aneurysmal dilation or dissection; no significant stenosis in left femoropopliteal segment or infrapopliteal vessels; no calcified or non-calcified plaque burden in left leg

Normal-sized liver without steatosis or mass; gallbladder without stones or wall thickening; kidneys symmetrical, no hydronephrosis or cortical thinning; aorta diameter 1.9 cm, no aneurysm or mural thrombus
Bilateral common carotid arteries patent with <30% stenosis at bifurcations; no plaque ulceration or flow disturbance; vertebral arteries symmetric with antegrade flow
